sources.title: Lurantis-GX Flower Supply FAQ
sources.supports: Discard Energy selection is exactly two if available; attach one if only one exists; with none the attack still deals damage.

sources.title: Zoroark-GX Trade FAQ
sources.supports: An empty hand prevents Trade activation. An empty deck does not; one remaining card is drawn if only one remains.

sources.title: Eevee & Snorlax-GX
sources.supports: Cheer Up attaches one Energy card from hand to one own Pokemon.

sources.title: Kilowattrel ex official explanation
sources.supports: Return Charge switches to the Bench and attaches Basic Lightning Energy to the original attacker.

sources.title: Primarina-GX official explanation
sources.supports: Bubble Beat grows with Water Energy on the entire own field.

sources.title: Rotom
sources.supports: Cycle Draw discards a hand card before drawing two; Energy Assist distributes two Basic Energy from discard to the own Bench.

sources.title: Hop's Pincurchin ex
sources.supports: Counterattack Quills responds to opposing attack damage in the Active Spot with three counters on the actual attacker.

sources.title: Numel
sources.supports: Incandescent Body burns the actual attacker after opposing attack damage in the Active Spot.

sources.title: Qwilfish Poison Point FAQ
sources.supports: Counters alone and Bench damage do not trigger the reaction; lethal attack damage does. A switched-in replacement is not the attacker.

sources.title: Electivire Steel Short FAQ
sources.supports: Steel Short can paralyze a dual-type Metal Pokemon and can apply paralysis even when its damage is prevented.

scope: 169 newly supported components (122 attacks, 47 abilities), 130 fully supported cards and 14 existing discard-cost corrections.
boundaries: Only full recognized clauses are supported; remaining clauses keep the card unsupported.
Optional hand attachment prefixes keep their existing behavior.
Damage reactions use captured ATTACKING_POKEMON, with activeOnly:true and lethalOnly:false.
Activated Ability cost potential is separate from Trainer play potential; empty-hand affordability is unchanged.
